sentence: This project tests how drugs that block the mineralocorticoid receptor affect inflammation in Duchenne muscular dystrophy and compares them with current anti-inflammatory treatments.
This project studies how the immune response and reprogramming factors help turn somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells.
This project provides shared equipment and services for cancer genomics research, including sequencing, microbiome profiling and epigenetics.
This project builds an MRI method that uses deep learning to measure early brain tissue changes in Alzheimer Disease.
This project builds fluorescence tools to study how organelles interact and to deliver large molecules into cells.
This project builds AI tools that learn from several kinds of real-world clinical data to spot dementia early in all groups of patients.
This project develops a nanoparticle made of synthetic high-density lipoprotein and loaded with antibiotics to treat dental pulp necrosis and apical periodontitis.
This project uses staining and microscopes to measure mRNA, proteins and fibrosis in human lung tissue.
This project builds a platform that finds protein variants found only in tumors and uses them as drug targets for cancer treatment.
This project combines a high-throughput selection platform with machine learning to find protease modulators that act only on disease-related substrates.
This project uses a liver cancer mouse model to study how helper T cells help control tumors and improve the response to immunotherapy.
This project uses CRISPR-based methods to map how genes interact with each other in many kinds of bacteria.
This project tries to find out how signaling shapes lens development, which is linked to genetic causes of ocular syndromes.
This project uses a tool that shows single astrocyte networks in transparent brains to study how they are built and work.
This project builds a fast whole-brain quantitative MRI method to tell brain tumor progression from changes caused by treatment.
This project studies diseases that involve complex interactions between microbial challenge and the inflammatory responses of the host.
This project tests whether adding a secondary target for pain to repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation helps patients with major depressive disorder and fibromyalgia.
This project tests whether the drug troriluzole can lower glutamate and slow glioblastoma growth by disrupting signaling between neurons and glioblastoma cells.
This project studies whether higher cancer risk in women with primary ovarian insufficiency comes from a shared genetic cause or more mutations.
